test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
When 154 l* *of oil is removed from an upright cylindrical tank, the level falls down by 10 cm. What is the diameter (in cm) of the tank?

Take π = 22/7
solution:
**Given:**

Volume = 154 liters = 154000 cm³

The level falls down by 10 cm

Height, h = 10cm

**Formula used:**

The volume of a cylinder = π r²h

Diameter, d = 2r

**Calculation:**

The volume of a cylinder = π r2h

⇒ 154000 = 22over7 × r² × 10

⇒ r² = {154000×7}over{22×10} = 4900

⇒ r = sqrt{4900} = 70 cm

Diameter = 2r = 2 × 70 = 140 cm

**∴ The diameter of the tank is 140 cm.**
